data.source_message: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month and leave 50 to double back to 100. That’s $10,000 apiece each month if we stick to it. Can we agree to that limit and check our catches together each month? John, what do you think?
